---
name: Content error
about: Report a factual error, broken link, out-of-date regulation, or typo
title: "[content] <short description>"
labels: content-error
assignees: ''
---

## Where is the error?

**File:** e.g., `modules/06-privacy-laws.md`

**Section / heading:** e.g., "DPDP Act 2023 — penalties"

**Approximate line or paragraph:** _________

## What does it currently say?

> Quote the existing text.

## What should it say?

> Provide the correction.

## Citation or source

Link to the regulator, standards body, primary text, or other authoritative source supporting the correction. Reports without a citation are still welcome but slower to action.

- Source: _________

## Severity

- [ ] Typo or broken link (cosmetic).
- [ ] Out-of-date but the direction is correct (e.g., a deadline shifted).
- [ ] Materially misleading (a reader could make a wrong real-world decision based on this).

## Anything else

Optional: context, screenshots, or a suggested rewrite.
